summary: express-json-database polls remote feed and passes response to undeclared loader module
details: The package is published as 'express-json-database' but contains no database or Express integration. On calling the exported server() function, and every 30 seconds thereafter, index.js fetches text from https://cafrino-feed.onrender.com/api/feed following a challenge/attest token exchange and passes the response body to inlinearray(text, true). The remote content is unpinned, unverified, and sourced from a mutable Render-hosted host; the response is executed through an external loader rather than parsed as data. The 'inline-array' module invoked at runtime is not declared in package.json dependencies, so npm resolves whatever package currently owns that name on the registry — a dependency-confusion-shaped resolution path controlled by whoever registers or holds the name. The declared package purpose does not match the shipped code, which is the cover-story shape for a loader fetching attacker-swappable payloads.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
